svg.desc: Authored vector map drawn from content/spine/ (nodes + sheet-atlas.json) by tools/mapforge/render-sheet.mjs. Not a generated image.
svg.text: Bellfaith survey where the ground is walked; mariners' report beyond
This is a compiled chart, not a single hand's survey. Where a coast is drawn
as a bare outline the Bellfaith has walked ground behind it, though at this
scale only the bound is set down — the coasts and channels it was walked and
sounded for are the continent sheets' business. Every filled coast is set
down from masters' logs sworn at Gildmark harbour, not from any keel of
ours. A FILLED coast is reported, never vouched — the hatch and the ice
pattern alike; only a bare outline is ours.
· the far interiors, past what any crew has walked
· whatever lies past the ice edges
the trade wind · once a year
FILLS · SURVEYED AND REPORTED · THIS CHART DRAWS ONLY: ice shelf, reported — hearsay
